entries.canonical_text: I sort packages in a warehouse during the day, and go to evening high school at night. But I can't hand in my phone until school lets out. I can keep my promise not to touch it during class. During breaks, I want to answer work messages. Before, calls from work kept coming during class. I couldn't answer, and the missed calls just kept piling up on my screen. Later, they told me it was a problem that they couldn't reach me. I almost had my shifts cut. I give the money I earn to my family. I want to earn my workplace's trust myself. But I don't want to quit school. I've started to understand the lessons here. I don't want to choose between work and school. I promise I'll keep my phone at the bottom of my bag during class. So please listen to what I have to say before deciding.
